post.title: Who pays for your card rewards? Stores paid $198B in fees
post.ig:
Who pays for your card rewards? Start with the stores: US merchants paid $198.25B in card processing fees in 2025 (Nilson Report).

The biggest slice of each swipe fee goes to the bank that issued the card. Example: a $100 purchase at 2.36%, the 2025 average Visa/Mastercard credit fee, costs the store $2.36; a 2% card returns $2.
American Express took in $37.4B in discount revenue from merchants in 2025 and spent $18.4B on card member rewards.
A 2010 Boston Fed study estimated each cash-paying household paid card users about $149 a year through prices.

Sources: Nilson Report (Mar 2026), American Express FY2025 10-K, Boston Fed (2010), Reuters (June 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
